_why: Units whose vdata has no m_strCustomUnitIcon. The portraits are the ones the game itself shows for these unit classes in its ping wheel (scripts/ping_wheel_messages.vdata, build 6726): 'Push Patron' -> npcs/tier_3_boss, 'Push Shrine' -> npcs/shield_generator, Guardian -> npcs/tier_1_boss, Walker -> npcs/tier_2_boss, troopers -> npcs/trooper, 'Enemy Taking Mid Boss' -> minimap/super_neutral_marker, 'Sinner's Here' -> minimap/neutral_vault. Base Guardians have no portrait of their own and share the Guardian one. Rules are regexes on the unit id, first match wins; a unit's own m_strCustomUnitIcon always wins over a rule.
_why_summons: Review 2026-10-05 (unit cards still had glyphs): a hero's summon or placed object takes the art of the hero ability that makes it, matched by its model and class (Mini Turret: models/heroes_wip/mcginnis/turret -> McGinnis' turret portrait heroes/engineer_turret; the Spectral Wall, Goo Ball, Bounce Pad, Familiar's helpers, Mirage's beetles -> their abilities' icons); Rat King's rats (model ratking_minion) and their swarm the HUD icon the files give the swarm's own effect (npc_neutral_bug_rat_swarm.m_SwarmModifier.m_strHudIcon: ratking_nibble, the art of his Rat Swarm); the zipline trooper is a trooper (class npc_trooper, base trooper_base); the shield escort (class npc_escort) the minimap's escort marker; the removed rejuvenator and soul pickup units the art their misc.vdata namesakes carry (game_icons.json for the soul pickup). No art fits Overseer (rooftop pigeon), the Hideout's toys, test bugs and the removed summons: they keep the site's glyph.
_why_more: Review 2026-10-17 (seventeen grey unit squares on the home page): Solomon's bishop and queen take the marks the minimap draws for them (minimap/chessmaster_bishop, _queen); Violet's ink wall (citadel_artist_strokeblocker: its sound and particle are Living Ink's pull brush) the art of Living Ink; Graves' skeleton (model necro_shambler) the game's own necro_shambler picture; Calico's cat (model nano_catform_model, the model of her cat form) that ability's art; the removed field sentry (model engineer/turret) McGinnis' turret portrait. The Mid-Boss takes the getting-started map's full-size Mid-Boss mark (getting_started/map_rejuv: its minimap marker without the glow that left it a speck on its card). Still no art in the files: Overseer (rooftop pigeon), the flying spirit pigeons, the Hideout's toys, test bugs, weak points, the bot brain, ability volumes and the removed summons keep the site's glyph on their own pages, and the home page folds them into one '+N' tile.
_why_marks: Review 2026-10-17 (four identical red troopers in a row on the home page; Guardian and Base Guardian one picture): the game has one portrait for every trooper (npcs/trooper) and one for both Guardians (npcs/tier_1_boss), so a type that shares its portrait carries its role mark from the game files in the portrait's top-right corner (a rule's third column; tools/extract_icons.marked_art writes one SVG per type). Troopers: the build browser's role tags builds/citadel_build_tag_weapon (Trooper: a gun), _healing (Medic Trooper) and _melee (Melee Trooper); the zipline trooper the HUD's zipline mark (hud/zipline_icon). Guardians: the numerals the HUD draws over the objective bosses, hud/world_space/hero_info_panel_ultready_boss_tier1 (I, the lane Guardian) and _boss_barracks (IV, the Base Guardian). Types with a portrait of their own (Walker, Patron, Shrine) get no mark. Flat HUD marks (ability icons, minimap and map-legend markers, item masks) are stored under icons/units/_mark/ so a unit card insets them on its tile (extract_icons.unit_art_dir).
